column1: access length and data.  The implementation adds a separate FAST_MMIO
bus internally. This serves two purposes:
- minimize overhead for old userspace that does not use eventfd with lengtth = 0
- minimize disruption in other code (since we don't know the length
devices on the MMIO bus only get a valid address in write
way we don't need to touch all devices to teach them to handle
an invalid length)
At the moment
column2: this optimization only has effect for EPT on x86.

column1: It will be possible to speed up MMIO for NPT and MMU using the same
idea in the future.

column2: on VMX MMIO EVENTFD is essentially as fast as PIO.
